universe.name: NGX 15-security public-data audit universe
universe.selection_basis: Cross-sector, long-listed securities selected for data-feasibility testing; inclusion is not an investment recommendation.

methodology.marked_return: close-to-close return using every staged market price
methodology.market_proxy: equal-weight mean across available security returns

reasons: 11 aligned market excess-return observations are available
short-horizon momentum is permitted; conventional 12-1 momentum is blocked
verified daily volume and traded value are unavailable

methodology.official_return_interpretation: sensitivity series over selected holdings with an observed official-trade return
